s: I might have a prosperous journey
that I may be comforted together
by the things that are made
the things that are more excellent

w: G1722 G3588 G5318|PREP T-DSN A-DSN||εν τω φανερω

s: of him that was to come
shall lay any thing to the charge
of them that preach the gospel
the olive tree which is wild
to be brought on my way
to him that is of power
